sentences.text: Chenanisuchus is a dyrosaurid crocodylomorph distinguished by having the shortest snout relative to its skull length among its relatives, though this snout is thicker and less slender than in species like Sokotosuchus.
Based on a 60-centimeter skull, the adult animal is estimated to have reached 4 to 4.5 meters in length.
Fossils found in Mali indicate that Chenanisuchus survived the Cretaceous-Paleogene extinction event.
Chenanisuchus was discovered by expeditions in 2000 and formally described in 2005.
The estimated adult length is between 4 and 4.5 meters, calculated from a skull measuring 60 centimeters.
Chenanisuchus belongs to the family Dyrosauridae.
Fossil records place Chenanisuchus in the Thanetian stage, between 59.24 and 56 million years ago.
It is suggested that their ability to walk on the sea floor helped dyrosaurids like Chenanisuchus survive the K-Pg extinction.
